assessments.zone: Rural Kabinda and Ludimbi-Lukula areas (Kabinda and Ludimbi Lukula health zones, west and south of the city): Paroisse, Masoko, Ngombe, Kiseka, Kapamba, Lomo, etc.

Order rests on PNC posts at secteur and groupement level and on customary chiefs, and violence comes mainly from banditry and land or chieftaincy disputes. No armed group is reported to hold any part of the city; insecurity consists of crime and occasional political or social unrest. units.CD8102-kabinda: Kabinda territory (Lomami province) contains Kabinda city, the provincial capital, and the rural Kabinda, Ludimbi-Lukula and Kalonda-Est areas. No armed group is known to hold territory there: the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency reached parts of Lomami only briefly and left no lasting militia control. Kabinda city is a state stronghold, policed by the PNC, with provincial institutions, ANR and a significant FARDC garrison. Rural areas depend on PNC posts and customary chiefs, and insecurity there is mostly banditry and land or chieftaincy disputes. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule, with limited confidence.
